title: POTV Lobo Advanced Accessories Kit
description:
Who is the “Advanced” Accessories Kit for?

The POTV Lobo Advanced Accessories Bundle is for the experienced POTV Lobo user who wants to save some money and be prepared for anything. You’ve settled into a routine and are ready to upgrade your setup with a more refined package. It has all the things you know you need and a few things you didn’t know you needed.

These accessories are designed to take you and your sessions further with extra dosing capsules and travel caddies, a mini bubbler, a grinder, and much more.

Need a bundle with the very best? Check out the Enthusiast Bundle.

POTV Glass Curved Mini Bubbler

Cool your vapor anywhere you go with the bite-sized Curved Mini Bubbler. Dry hits are great, but sometimes you want a bigger hit that’s even cooler. This bubbler attaches directly to your POTV Lobo and provides portable water-conditioned vapor with a comfortable bent-neck mouthpiece and cool, massive sessions.

POTV 4 Piece Grinder

Grind and shred your herbs to perfection with a more durable and consistent shredder. The POTV 4 Piece Grinder. This grinder comes with a grinding plate and lid, an herb catcher, and a bottom pollen catcher to collect the good stuff. Pollen scraper included.

The Scoop

Prep your sessions like a pro with the perfect Scoop. This stainless steel scoop is perfectly sized to slide in and out of your POTV Lobo vaporizer with ease and fills the oven with one full scoop. Its open-mouth design gives full visibility of what you’re scooping and captures a large load in one shovel.

Plus, it has a magnetic end that can safely remove a hot dosing capsule from your Lobo! Simply attach the hot capsule to the magnetic end, remove it from the oven, and then drop it down on another magnetic surface

Two Sets of Lobo Dosing Capsules (8)

Dosing capsules are awesome, so we’ve included an extra set (8 total) of Lobo Dosing Capsules to help power your sessions. Prepack a handful and chain multiple sessions together with minimal downtime. These capsules are great for multiple sessions in rapid succession, nailing the perfect dose every time, and even help keep your vape cleaner for longer.

Comes with two sets of Lobo Dosing Capsules for eight total.

POTV Lobo Capsule Caddy and Caddy Insert

Carry your preloaded sessions wherever you go with the POTV Lobo Capsule Caddy! This durable, metallic caddy securely holds up to four POTV Lobo dosing capsules and protects them with a smell-proof and water-proof seal. Pack your capsules, pop them in the caddy, and attach it to your keychain, belt loop, or bag using the included keychain ring for easy travel.

Need more storage for a long trip? Place the Capsule Caddy Insert into your tightvac container and convert it into a dosing capsule organizer! This caddy insert comes with three numbered columns to hold and organize up to 18 total capsules and a storage slot for stir tools, brushes, or boveda packs.

Two Lobo Concentrate Pads

One concentrate pad isn’t enough – the flavors mingle, and they start to blend between different blends. These extras will give your concentrates the distinction they deserve, and keep the sessions rolling while the original pad is soaking clean.

Just load the pad inside the included dosing capsule, place a small amount of concentrate onto the pad, and it’s good to go! Set the temperature to 430°F / 221°C and take long, slow sips once it vibrates.

For use with waxes and solid concentrates only. Use the included dosing capsule and only a very small amount when vaporizing concentrates. Use with liquid concentrates may ruin your device and is not covered under warranty.

POTV Lobo Replacement Battery

Skip the charge times and never miss a puff with a spare POTV Lobo Battery. This is an exact replacement for the Lobo and is a must-have accessory to keep the sessions rolling. When it’s time to recharge, simply unscrew the battery lid on the bottom, swap in the fresh battery, and jump right back into your session.

To keep your extra battery/batteries charged, we recommend using an external charger. If you don’t have one, they are available here.

POTV Lobo Replacement Screens and Alcohol Swabs

Keep your Lobo in prime condition with a set of replacement screens. These screens sit underneath the glass adapter to prevent herbs from entering the mouthpiece and will collect debris over time. Skip the deep cleanings with a quick swap and keep your Lobo performing at its best.

Use the Snaps prefilled cotton swaps to deep clean a messy Lobo oven chamber. Hold the end with the blue line up, snap it to release the alcohol to the other end, and swab away any tough residue.

Cleaning Disclaimer: DO NOT insert anything into the dimpled stem when cleaning. Clean with warm water and a mild grease-cutting dishwashing detergent such as Dawn or isopropyl alcohol.

Return policy

We do not accept used accessories returned on their own. However, your items are eligible for return through our 30-day policy if they are unused and unopened.
